mentions.name: 2025 project write-ups on engineersneedart.com
mentions.description: This project is a set of belated write-ups documenting the author's completed 2025 projects, published on engineersneedart.com and inspired by the 'TADA list' idea of logging finished work.
mentions.problem: Regret over not having written up projects as they were completed during 2025.
mentions.source_excerpt: I saw the "TADA" post a week or so back (like "TODO" but you finished it—"Tada!") and I regretted not having done write ups for projects I did in 2025. So I'm doing that belatedly. (https://engineersneedart.com)
